comment: Expected row counts for secondary register lines per fiscal year, used by the row_count_fy validator. Set to null for FYs where the actual count has not yet been established (loader will emit a warning but not fail). Update these counts once the real registers have been ingested and verified. State Head Dashboard FYs (2025-26, 2026-27) are not counted here — those are validated by the all_months_present and anomaly validators instead.
